description: Custom extended EditText component with undo/redo functionality, clipboard management, and text manipulation features for Android.

classes.name: ExtendedEditText
classes.description: A custom EditText with added features like undo/redo, clipboard management, and selective text watcher execution.

classes.name: TextChange
classes.description: Data class representing a change in text, used for undo/redo history.

methods.name: onTextContextMenuItem
methods.description: Overrides context menu item handling to prevent pasting rich text, replacing it with plain text.

methods.name: withoutTextWatchers
methods.description: Executes a block of code without notifying any TextWatchers.

methods.name: withOnlyTextWatcher
methods.description: Executes a block of code notifying only TextWatchers of a specific type.

methods.name: withoutTextWatcher
methods.description: Executes a block of code without notifying TextWatchers of a specific type.

methods.name: addTextChangedListener
methods.description: Adds a TextWatcher to the internal list and the superclass.

methods.name: removeTextChangedListener
methods.description: Removes a TextWatcher from the internal list and the superclass.

methods.name: requestFocusAndMoveCaret
methods.description: Requests focus and moves the cursor to the end of the text.

methods.name: enableUndoRedo
methods.description: Enables undo/redo functionality with saved state restoration.

methods.name: setOnCanUndoRedoListener
methods.description: Sets a listener to monitor undo/redo availability.

methods.name: canUndo
methods.description: Checks if undo operation is possible.

methods.name: canRedo
methods.description: Checks if redo operation is possible.

methods.name: saveHistory
methods.description: Saves current undo/redo history to saved state registry.
